detail: internal/daemon's TestWatchTasksStreamsSnapshotChangesAndTicks fails under load from parallel test runs ('WatchTasks ended with context canceled', taskwatch_test.go:117): about 4 of 16 full package runs on the SP-070 branch while three feature agents tested on this machine, 0 of 3 on main and 0 of 4 on the branch when the machine was quieter, 10 of 10 alone. The test and internal/daemon/taskwatch.go are untouched by SP-070. Likely cause: when the client cancels while WatchTasks is sending a tick or a change (the test's tick is 50 ms), the send returns the context error instead of WatchTasks returning nil. Fix in WatchTasks (return nil when ctx.Err() is set after a failed send) or add to the flaky list with RC-39.
note: Resolved on 2026-11-11 by https://github.com/willesq/orchestrator/pull/168 (fixed on the user's instruction): WatchTasks now returns nil when a read or send fails after the client's context is done (a cancel during a snapshot, change or tick read, or select picking a ready tick or change over ctx.Done). TestWatchTasksEndsCleanlyWhenClientGoesAwayMidRead cancels at each read point and failed on every run before the fix.
